title: Computer Science Open Days September 2026 Feedback
description: Collect feedback from visitors and staff on their experiences at the Computer Science Open Days to inform improvements to future events.
scope_note: This survey branches immediately into separate paths for visitors (prospective students or parents) and staff. For visitors: capture which activities they experienced, their feelings about activities and reasons, unmet expectations, and their understanding of CS study. For staff: capture which activities they helped with, how smoothly they ran, sufficiency of training and support, and suggestions for improvement. Do not ask visitors about staff logistics or vice versa.
steering_note: For visitors with strong feelings: let them lead on depth — accept brief answers like 'boring' and follow up with 'what could have made it better?' rather than requiring detailed explanation upfront. For staff: ask about each activity type they mention before moving to training and support. Do not prompt suggestions for improvement until they've indicated insufficient training or support.
summary_questions: Which open day activities did you experience or help with?
What were your strong feelings about those activities, and what caused them?
For staff: was your training and support sufficient, and what would have helped? For visitors: did the open day increase your understanding of Computer Science study?

respondent_type.question: Are you visiting the open day, or are you staff helping to run it?
respondent_type.objective: Identifies whether respondent is a visitor or staff member to route to appropriate branch.

children.description: Respondent is attending as a visitor.
Respondent is staff helping to run the open day.

visitor_type.question: Are you a prospective student or a parent?
visitor_type.objective: Classifies visitor as prospective student or parent to understand their perspective.

children.description: Respondent is a prospective student.
Respondent is a parent attending.

visitor_activities_experienced.question: Which of the open day activities did you experience today? The activities include presentations, tours, Robot Dogs, VR and Smart Glasses, and student internship projects.
visitor_activities_experienced.objective: Respondent names at least one activity they took part in or attended.

children.description: Respondent names one or more activities they experienced.
Respondent did not experience any activities or is unsure.

visitor_strong_feelings.question: Which of those activities did you have strong feelings about — either really liked or really disliked?
visitor_strong_feelings.objective: Respondent names at least one activity they had a strong opinion about.

children.description: Respondent identifies one or more activities they felt strongly about.
Respondent had neutral feelings about all activities or didn't want to elaborate.

visitor_feelings_why.question: Why did you feel that way about it? What stood out?
visitor_feelings_why.objective: Respondent gives at least one reason for their strong feeling — whether a brief label like 'boring' or a more detailed explanation.

children.description: Respondent explains what they liked or disliked.
Respondent unable or unwilling to explain further.

visitor_improve_activity.question: Is there anything you would change about those activities, or anything that could have made the experience better?
visitor_improve_activity.objective: Respondent suggests at least one improvement, or explicitly states they would not change anything.

children.description: Respondent offers a suggestion for improvement.
Respondent feels activities were fine as they were.

visitor_other_activities_feedback.question: For the other activities you tried but didn't feel strongly about, do you have any comments or feedback?
visitor_other_activities_feedback.objective: Respondent provides comments on remaining activities, or indicates none are needed.

children.description: Respondent comments on other activities.
Respondent has no further feedback.

visitor_unmet_expectations.question: Was there anything you expected or hoped to see or experience at the open day that wasn't available?
visitor_unmet_expectations.objective: Respondent identifies unmet expectations or confirms they saw what they wanted.

children.description: Respondent names something they hoped to see but didn't.
Respondent's expectations were met or they had none.

visitor_cs_understanding.question: Do you feel today's open day increased your understanding of what studying Computer Science is like?
visitor_cs_understanding.objective: Respondent indicates whether the open day expanded their knowledge of CS study.

children.description: Respondent feels they learned more about CS study.
Respondent's understanding was unchanged.
Respondent feels their understanding was clarified negatively.

visitor_application_likelihood.question: Has today's open day helped you make your mind up about applying to study Computer Science, and how likely do you think you are to apply?
visitor_application_likelihood.objective: Respondent indicates their current likelihood to apply and whether the day moved them toward a decision.

children.description: Respondent indicates they are likely or more likely to apply.
Respondent indicates they are unlikely to apply.
Respondent remains undecided about applying.

visitor_end.question: Thank you for your feedback today.

staff_activities_intro.question: Which activities did you help with or experience today? This could include presentations, tours, demos and activities like Robot Dogs or VR and Smart Glasses, or student internship projects.
staff_activities_intro.objective: Respondent names at least one activity type they were involved in or witnessed.

children.description: Respondent identifies one or more activities they helped with.
Respondent was not directly involved in activities.

staff_activity_smoothness.question: For those activities, how did things go? Did they run smoothly, or were there challenges?
staff_activity_smoothness.objective: Respondent describes whether each activity or overall operation ran smoothly and names any challenges encountered.

children.description: Activities ran smoothly or mostly smoothly.
Respondent identifies one or more challenges.

staff_training_sufficiency.question: Do you feel you had sufficient training and support to help with those activities?
staff_training_sufficiency.objective: Respondent indicates whether they felt adequately prepared and supported.

children.description: Respondent felt adequately trained and supported.
Respondent felt they lacked training or support.

staff_suggest_training.question: What training or support would have helped you? What do you think would have made your experience better?
staff_suggest_training.objective: Respondent suggests specific training, resources, or support that was missing.

children.description: Respondent suggests training or support improvements.
Respondent unable to specify improvements.

staff_improve_experience.question: How do you think your overall experience helping with the open day could be improved?
staff_improve_experience.objective: Respondent offers at least one suggestion for improving the staff experience, or indicates they were satisfied.

children.description: Respondent suggests improvements.
Respondent satisfied with experience as-is.

staff_end.question: Thank you for helping to make the open day a success.
